tools.name: search_packs
tools.description: Search the Symbola registry for packs: software a coding agent can build from its decisions. Matches words against each pack's name, summary, id and category. With no query, lists every pack.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Overview of one pack: what it builds, its version, how many decisions it holds, its components, its page and download link, and the files it holds.

tools.name: read_decisions
tools.description: The decisions a pack makes: each one a rule a builder could get wrong, with its status (decided, default or open). Narrow them to one component or to decisions mentioning some words.

tools.name: read_pack_file
tools.description: Read one file of a pack, e.g. PRODUCT.md (the whole product), AGENTS.md (how to build it), BRIEF.md, obligations.toml, an assumption, or a component's symbolon.toml or examples.jsonl. "pack.md" is the whole pack as one Markdown page.

tools.name: get_build_steps
tools.description: How to build a pack: the steps a coding agent with a shell follows (install the symbola CLI, pull the pack, build each component and run its checks), and a one-line request the user can paste into Claude Code or another coding agent.
